equivalence_metrics.name: mean_signed_price_error_in_baseline_se
equivalence_metrics.source: intake/brief.md and intake/benchmark.json describe baseline discounted 1.96-standard-error confidence widths. Divide each baseline confidence width by 1.96 to obtain baseline Monte Carlo SE. Scientific margin is one baseline SE in dimensionless SE units, a prospective uncertainty-based criterion, not a published numeric L1 tolerance or measured variability.
equivalence_metrics.definition: For each seed and fixed input, baseline alone supplies SE_i = discounted Confidence_i / 1.96. Arm metric = mean_i((MC_arm_i - BS_i) / SE_i). Use the same baseline SE_i denominators for both arms. Paired difference is method metric minus baseline metric. Thus absolute margin 1 means one baseline per-option Monte Carlo SE on the mean signed standardized price error. Require all SE_i finite and positive; otherwise equivalence is unavailable and cannot pass. Never estimate denominators or margins from method outputs.
equivalence_metrics.availability: Per-option MC, BS and baseline confidence widths are required evaluation observations; intake contains no numeric values. Printed aggregate stdout alone cannot compute this metric; missing observations make evaluation VOID, not equivalent.

confidence_rule.decision: Use exact binomial order-statistic bounds: one-sided lower confidence bound for median paired baseline-wall/method-wall ratio; two-sided paired-difference interval with Bonferroni across all equivalence metrics (one metric). Equivalence requires entire interval strictly inside (-1,1). Require performance lower bound >= minimum_worthwhile_gain and equivalence separately; lack of significance never establishes equivalence. Report each budget separately; a claim of success across budgets requires every budget to pass. No selecting a favorable budget.

power_planning.assumptions: Prospective planning assumption only: independent seed pairs, true median difference zero, paired standardized differences normally distributed with SD <= 1. With 64 seed pairs, the exact 95% two-sided median interval uses order statistics 24 and 41. Under N(0,1), the probability either endpoint crosses +/-1 is bounded by twice P(Binomial(64,Phi(1)) <= 40), below 0.01; hence power exceeds 0.99 under this assumption. No baseline variance or empirical power is available. Failure of assumption means power is unverified; do not retune sample count or margin after inspecting results.

hardware_cost_basis.accounting: Budget is allocated GPU count multiplied by elapsed timed wall seconds per arm and per seed observation. Charge all allocated devices during serial host work, launch, transfers, waiting and merge. Report both wall speedup and GPU-second ratio. Evaluation replication and warmup costs are additional and separately reported.
hardware_cost_basis.environment: Intake target: Lambda Stack, Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA 12.8, driver 570. Use same host and same eight GPU pool; baseline uses GPU 0, method uses GPUs 0-7. Pin actual GPU model, driver patch, libc, toolkit and geometry before evaluation; unavailable or heterogeneous hardware invalidates comparison. Profile reports eight GPUs; representative baseline specifies one. Profile scale and hardware identity remain unverified.

timing_scope.description: Time complete invocation through synchronized successful exit, including launch, option preprocessing, H2D/D2H transfers, all pricing kernels, synchronization, cross-device merge, CPU finalization and validation. Include allocation and RNG initialization consistently in both arms; exclude compilation. This deliberately includes more than upstream reported streamed Total time. Report upstream time secondarily. Profile timing provenance is incomplete, so its bound is used solely as the supplied ceiling, not a measured process-wall forecast.

evaluation_inputs.generation: Use pinned upstream host generator with srand(123), preserving draw order and identical libc in both arms. Generate once and share identical ordered option arrays. No input hash supplied; record generated array hashes before observing results.
evaluation_inputs.rng_pairing: Upstream has no seed CLI and geometry-dependent streams. Future evaluation adapter must expose sealed seeds and map each seed, global option index and path index to identical cuRAND logical streams across arms, independently of device partition. Freeze mapping before results; use disjoint streams across listed seeds. Preserve distribution and path count. Without seed control and paired logical stream identity, do not substitute deterministic repetitions: evaluation is VOID.
evaluation_inputs.partition: Method partitions the same 1048576 options into eight contiguous chunks of 131072; retain original order after merge. No replication, extra paths, or changed option count.

splits.policy: Numerical simulation; no training split. All sealed seeds and input are held out from method tuning. Published 8192-option anchor case is validation only and never contributes representative timing or power.

budget_protocol: Each budget is a per-observation cap in GPU-seconds, identical across arms: wall limit budget/allocated_gpus. Keep fixed options and paths. Budget exhaustion is timeout, never partial output or imputed speedup. Separate timing pairs and 64 scientific seed pairs are required at each budget; do not pool duplicate deterministic observations across budgets. Stage limits from intake remain hard limits; insufficient time to finish the sealed protocol means incomplete/VOID, not fewer samples.
warmup_protocol: One full fixed-scale invocation per arm before observations at each budget, using reserved seed 9001, excluded from timing and equivalence samples. Warmup failure or timeout invalidates that budget. No adaptive warmup.
scheduling_protocol: Use a fixed PRNG initialized to scheduling seed to shuffle the 64 seed-pair order per budget and independently choose AB or BA inside each pair. Run arms sequentially with exclusive GPU allocation and no overlapping workloads. Nine timing pairs use the first nine sealed scientific seeds; all 64 pairs supply scientific observations. Retain all pairs, including failures; no outlier deletion, early stopping, retries or optional stopping.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work Monte Carlo benchmark: 1048576 options and 262144 paths per option; no published L1 target or calibrated outcome-versus-budget curve. Compare wall time only conditional on statistical equivalence and baseline scientific acceptance; budgets impose timeouts, not path-count changes.

scientific_acceptance: At published anchor scale 8192 options, require reserve > 1, Test passed and successful exit, respecting strict inequality and unrounded boundary. At representative scale require successful completion, finite outputs and same scientific acceptance predicate in each arm and seed. These are upstream validity predicates, not exact stochastic equivalence metrics. Record L1 norm without inventing an L1 target.

seal_policy: Prospective protocol only; no method code, builds, workloads or external retrieval performed. Any scope, tolerance, seed, input, RNG mapping or sample-count change requires a new sealed run.
